description: Compare visitor insurance plan benefits side by side for up to 4 plan_ids returned by search_visitor_insurance_plans. Returns the compare page's benefit rows and highlights per plan, plus the brochure link when available. Default sections can be narrowed with the sections input. Pass the same deductible_usd you used in search_visitor_insurance_plans so the benefits and link match that option; without it, details describe the plan's default option ($250 deductible when offered, else the lowest).

deductible_usd.description: Optional exact deductible in USD (for example 250 for $250); picks the option the benefits and link describe.

plan_ids.description: One to four plan_id values from search_visitor_insurance_plans.

sections.description: Benefit sections to include. Default: all five sections.

coverage_area.description: Worldwide coverage that includes the US and Canada (default), or US-only coverage.

end_date.description: Last day of coverage as YYYY-MM-DD; at least one day after start_date.

start_date.description: First day of coverage as YYYY-MM-DD; today (UTC) or later.

traveler_age.description: The traveler's age in whole years on the coverage start date; carriers price by that age.

name: get_visitor_insurance_plan_details
title: Compare plan benefits side by side
